g.title: video_processor_resets
g.text: arst_n (external, asynchronous, active low) resets only the CPU system, held until the CPU PLL locks. The core logic stays in reset until the firmware writes SYSCTL CORE_RESET = 1

(with the video PLL locked); every CPU reset (arst_n, PLL lock loss or watchdog) clears CORE_RESET and so puts the core logic back into reset. Each reset_sync asserts asynchronously and releases after 2 flops of its own clock.
Domains tagged `VP_* exist only when that interface is enabled in src/configuration.sv. Bold = library IP module name, grey = instance name.
